extracted.intended_audience: members and staff of federal advisory committees, agency officials responsible for FACA compliance, and members of the public interested in advisory committee governance
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and legal text describing the Federal Advisory Committee Act (FACA), the statutory framework governing how federal advisory committees operate, with emphasis on meeting openness, chartering, public involvement, and reporting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal foundation for advisory committee operations
rubrics_metrics.description: The Federal Advisory Committee Act became law in 1972 and is the legal foundation defining how federal advisory committees operate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes the statutory framework under which advisory committees must function; the page provides links to the full Act (annotated and unannotated) as the authoritative text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open meetings emphasis
rubrics_metrics.description: The law has special emphasis on open meetings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advisory committees are expected to conduct meetings openly; the Act and related guidance set rules and procedures to ensure meetings are accessible to the public (see the full Act linked on the page for detailed provisions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Chartering requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The law has special emphasis on chartering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advisory committees must be properly chartered under the statutory requirements; the chartering process and required charter contents are governed by FACA (detailed provisions available in the linked Act documents).

rubrics_metrics.name: Public involvement requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The law has special emphasis on public involvement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FACA mandates mechanisms for public participation and input into advisory committee processes; the page points users to the full statutory text for specifics on notice, opportunities to comment, and participation rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: The law has special emphasis on reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advisory committees are subject to reporting requirements under FACA (e.g., disclosures, records, and reports); the page links to the Act for the exact reporting standards and procedures.
